name: StackPerch 0.1.0 Preview — Repository migration
body:
StackPerch 仓库迁移预览版（原名 KeepAny）。

StackPerch, formerly KeepAny, is a local digital asset workspace for independent developers. This preview moves the repository and public documentation to StackPerch and updates the source links inside the portable package. The application runtime is byte-identical to the previously verified StackPerch preview. Commercial features are unchanged.

Download the attached portable ZIP, extract it to a fixed folder, then run `start.command` (macOS), `start.bat` (Windows) or `./start.sh` (Linux). Node.js 22+ is required; Git, pnpm, registration and a build step are not required. Open `http://127.0.0.1:4180/`. Keep your original browser and exact address to retain existing records; existing `.ka1` backups and `.kdbx` vaults remain compatible and require their original passwords. Read the [English website](https://syndred.github.io/StackPerch/) and [trial guide](https://github.com/Syndred/StackPerch/blob/7ebc2c349f4826759c8b2ef848e8c6133c0b3858/docs/%E8%AF%95%E7%94%A8%E6%8C%87%E5%8D%97.md#english).

Legacy GitHub links redirect to this same repository. The old website provides an immediate HTML refresh and direct link to the new site; JavaScript retains query strings and fragments. This remains an early preview: the recorded automated and browser checks are not a guarantee for every real device, provider or power-loss case. Public crawler access does not guarantee GPT indexing or recommendations.

仓库、README、官网及便携包源码指向已统一为 [Syndred/StackPerch](https://github.com/Syndred/StackPerch)。旧 GitHub 地址仍可进入同一仓库，旧官网入口保留兼容跳转。

官网：[中文](https://syndred.github.io/StackPerch/zh/) · [English](https://syndred.github.io/StackPerch/)。

下载下方 StackPerch ZIP，解压后运行 macOS 的 start.command、Windows 的 start.bat 或 Linux 的 start.sh。需要 Node.js 22+，无需 Git、pnpm 或注册；默认本机地址继续为 [http://127.0.0.1:4180/](http://127.0.0.1:4180/)。保持原浏览器与原地址可继续使用既有数据。

应用运行文件与前一 StackPerch 已验证版保持一致；本次更新仓库链接和对应源代码分发。旧存储、KDBX 字段、备份格式及协议标识保留。商业功能未扩展。

验证：803 项单元测试（真实 PostgreSQL）、187 项固定文件工作流、187 项便携包工作流、同步2、并发5、离线1、旧版升级1，以及 macOS/Windows/Linux 便携包 CI。官网与旧入口另有中英双语和无 JavaScript 验收。

源提交：7ebc2c349f4826759c8b2ef848e8c6133c0b3858。

StackPerch-0.1.0-preview.7ebc2c349f48-portable.zip SHA-256：
`48cf9866866b17efed4c3b28e6920e622af35ca58e122c34e72abc50f6741a47`

早期预览仍可能存在缺陷，请定期导出备份并验证恢复。完整操作见[试用指南](https://github.com/Syndred/StackPerch/blob/7ebc2c349f4826759c8b2ef848e8c6133c0b3858/docs/%E8%AF%95%E7%94%A8%E6%8C%87%E5%8D%97.md)。开源核心使用 AGPL-3.0-only；付费托管尚未开放。

同源码 CI / Same-commit CI: [Release workflows](https://github.com/Syndred/StackPerch/actions/runs/38500663605) · [macOS / Windows / Linux package checks](https://github.com/Syndred/StackPerch/actions/runs/38500663726).
